content:
Downloads a scan report for the specified scan.
Note: A 404 Not Found is returned if the requested report is not yet ready for download.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the WAS.SCAN_WAS.READ  custom role privilege. Additionally,
requires the Can View [16] scan permission. See Roles and Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the scan for which you want to view a report.
HEADER PARAMETERS
string
Enum: "application/json"
"application/pdf"
"text/csv"
"text/html"
"text/xml"
The format you want the report returned in. You can request reports in one
of the following formats:
application/json
application/pdf
text/csv
text/html
text/xml
